summary: Iron Rabbit REPAIR #3 — Backup/Restore Data-Integrity Audit. Executed all 13 round-trip tests + regression invariant check directly in the running app via a temporary window.__test hook (added, run, then removed — no committed code change). Every test PASSED with zero data-fidelity defects. exportAllData() → clear stores → importAllData() faithfully round-trips notes (including deep 4-level category_path arrays, uncategorized empty state, forward-compat fields like foo='bar'), settings (pinned_categories, pinned_subcategory_paths with nested arrays, category_order, sticky_categories, sort_by, custom_sort_rules), templates, and attachment blobs (byte-for-byte identical across image/png, image/jpeg, application/pdf). Empty-DB round-trip produced no fake records. Repair #1 invariant (category === category_path[0] || '' && subcategory === category_path[1] || '') held for every restored note. TEST 14 static inspection of migrateFromBackend (L608-649) confirmed reported behavior. AUDIT VERDICT: CLEAN — no code changes required.

Settings response is fetched but the current code path does NOT persist settings back to settingsStore (only notes and templates are written). This is a documented limitation, not a fidelity regression against manual backup/restore.

critical_code_review_comments: migrateFromBackend (L608-649) fetches /api/settings but never writes it to settingsStore — only notes and templates are persisted. If server-restore is ever expected to hydrate settings, this is a gap. Not in scope of Repair #3; flag for future review.

migrateFromBackend does not fetch or restore attachment blobs. Server-side attachments (if any exist) will not be brought back by this path. Manual backup/restore JSON is the only fidelity-preserving path — as documented in the audit request.
seed_data_creation: All seed data written directly to IndexedDB (localforage instances name='IronRabbit', stores notes/settings/templates/files) inside page.evaluate; wiped between tests and cleared at end.
